units.source_text: 丈夫突然从嵯峨挂来电话，说要她把女儿带来，去御宝 [2] 赏花。

en.t: Her husband suddenly called from Saga and told her to bring their daughter so they could go to Otakara [2] to view the flowers.

units.source_text: 阿繁不知如何是好，因为她从来没有跟丈夫去赏过花。

en.t: Ashige did not know what to do, because she had never gone flower viewing with her husband before.
